Uruk.name: Gilgamesh
Uruk.note: Legendary hero king, later the subject of the Epic of Gilgamesh.
Uruk.note_zh: 传说中的英雄国王，后来成为《吉尔伽美什史诗》的主人公。

Uruk.name: Lugal-zage-si
Uruk.note: Conquered Lagash and most of Sumer before Sargon defeated him.
Uruk.note_zh: 征服拉格什和苏美尔大部分地区，后被萨尔贡击败。

check.n: Wikipedia gives fl. c. 2520 BC (en) or c. 2550 BC (zh).
check.n_zh: 维基载约前2520年（英）/前2550年（中）在位。

check.n: Wikipedia says died c. 2368 BC; zh reign 2378-2371 BC.
check.n_zh: 维基称约前2368年卒；在位前2378年—前2371年。

people.name: Gilgamesh
people.known_for: Legendary king of Uruk whose deeds became the Epic of Gilgamesh, the oldest great work of literature.
people.known_for_zh: 传说中的乌鲁克国王，他的事迹成为现存最古老的文学巨著《吉尔伽美什史诗》。

people.name: Enmebaragesi
people.known_for: King of Kish and the earliest ruler on the Sumerian King List confirmed by his own inscriptions.
people.known_for_zh: 基什国王，是《苏美尔王表》中最早有本人铭文可以证实的统治者。

people.name: Kubaba
people.known_for: Tavern keeper who, the Sumerian King List says, became ruler of Kish, the only woman on the list.
people.known_for_zh: 据《苏美尔王表》记载，她原是酒馆老板，后来成为基什的统治者，是王表上唯一的女性。

people.name: Puabi
people.known_for: Queen of Ur whose richly furnished tomb in the Royal Cemetery revealed the wealth of Sumer.
people.known_for_zh: 乌尔王后，她在王陵中的豪华墓葬展示了苏美尔的财富和工艺水平。

people.name: Mesannepada
people.known_for: Founder of the First Dynasty of Ur, who also took the title King of Kish.
people.known_for_zh: 乌尔第一王朝的建立者，同时拥有“基什之王”的称号。

people.name: Ur-Nanshe
people.known_for: Founder of the First Dynasty of Lagash, known from reliefs showing him building temples.
people.known_for_zh: 拉格什第一王朝的建立者，浮雕上描绘了他亲自修建神庙的形象。

people.name: Eannatum
people.known_for: King of Lagash who defeated Umma and recorded his victory on the Stele of the Vultures.
people.known_for_zh: 拉格什国王，战胜温马，并在“鹫碑”上记录了这次胜利。

people.name: Entemena
people.known_for: King of Lagash whose clay cone records one of the earliest known border treaties.
people.known_for_zh: 拉格什国王，他的泥锥铭文记录了已知最早的边界条约之一。

people.name: Urukagina
people.known_for: Ruler of Lagash famous for the earliest known reforms protecting the poor against officials.
people.known_for_zh: 拉格什统治者，以已知最早的社会改革著称，限制官吏盘剥，保护贫弱。

check.n: Wikipedia says died c. 2368 BC; zh reign 2378-2371 BC.
check.n_zh: 维基称约前2368年卒；在位前2378年—前2371年。

people.name: Lugal-zage-si
people.known_for: King of Umma and Uruk who briefly united Sumer before Sargon of Akkad overthrew him.
people.known_for_zh: 温马和乌鲁克国王，曾短暂统一苏美尔，后被阿卡德的萨尔贡推翻。

people.name: Sargon of Akkad
people.known_for: Founder of the Akkadian Empire, the first empire in history, uniting all of Mesopotamia.
people.known_for_zh: 阿卡德王国的建立者，统一了整个两河流域，建立了历史上第一个帝国。

people.name: Ur-Zababa
people.known_for: King of Kish in whose court, according to legend, the young Sargon served as cupbearer.
people.known_for_zh: 基什国王，据传说年轻的萨尔贡曾在他的宫廷中担任司酒官。

people.name: Enheduanna
people.known_for: Daughter of Sargon and high priestess at Ur, the first author in history known by name.
people.known_for_zh: 萨尔贡之女，乌尔月神庙的最高女祭司，是历史上第一位留下姓名的作者。

people.name: Rimush
people.known_for: Son of Sargon who crushed revolts of the Sumerian cities.
people.known_for_zh: 萨尔贡之子，镇压了苏美尔各城市的反叛。

people.name: Manishtushu
people.known_for: King of Akkad who campaigned across the Persian Gulf and bought land recorded on his obelisk.
people.known_for_zh: 阿卡德国王，曾越过波斯湾远征，他的方尖碑记录了购买土地的契约。

people.name: Naram-Sin
people.known_for: Grandson of Sargon who took the title King of the Four Quarters and was worshipped as a god.
people.known_for_zh: 萨尔贡之孙，自称“四方之王”，并被奉为神，留下著名的胜利石碑。

people.name: Lugal-ushumgal
people.known_for: Governor of Lagash under Naram-Sin and Shar-Kali-Sharri, known from his seals and inscriptions.
people.known_for_zh: 纳拉姆辛和沙尔卡利沙瑞时期的拉格什总督，事迹见于他的印章和铭文。

check.n: Wikipedia says ruled c. 2230-2210 BC, died c. 2210 BC.
check.n_zh: 维基称约前2230年—前2210年在位，约前2210年卒。

people.name: Ur-Baba
people.known_for: Ruler of Lagash after the fall of Akkad who began the revival of the city, father-in-law of Gudea.
people.known_for_zh: 阿卡德衰落后的拉格什统治者，开启了该城的复兴，是古地亚的岳父。

people.name: Shar-Kali-Sharri
people.known_for: Last strong king of Akkad, who fought the Gutians and Amorites as the empire weakened.
people.known_for_zh: 阿卡德最后一位有作为的国王，在帝国衰落时与库提人和阿摩利人作战。

people.name: Gudea
people.known_for: Ruler of Lagash famous for his many statues and long inscriptions about rebuilding temples.
people.known_for_zh: 拉格什统治者，以大量雕像和记述重修神庙的长篇铭文著称。

people.name: Utu-hengal
people.known_for: King of Uruk who drove the Gutians out of Sumer.
people.known_for_zh: 乌鲁克国王，把库提人赶出了苏美尔。

people.name: Ur-Nammu
people.known_for: Founder of the Third Dynasty of Ur, builder of the Great Ziggurat and author of the oldest known law code.
people.known_for_zh: 乌尔第三王朝的建立者，修建乌尔大塔庙，颁布了已知最早的法典。

people.name: Shulgi
people.known_for: Long-reigning king of Ur who reformed weights, the calendar and administration and was deified.
people.known_for_zh: 乌尔国王，在位很久，统一度量衡和历法，整顿行政，并被奉为神。

people.name: Amar-Sin
people.known_for: King of Ur who continued temple building at Eridu and Nippur.
people.known_for_zh: 乌尔国王，继续在埃利都和尼普尔修建神庙。

people.name: Shu-Sin
people.known_for: King of Ur who built a long wall to keep out the Amorites.
people.known_for_zh: 乌尔国王，修筑长墙以阻挡阿摩利人。

people.name: Ibbi-Sin
people.known_for: Last king of Ur III, carried off by the Elamites when Ur fell.
people.known_for_zh: 乌尔第三王朝末代国王，乌尔陷落后被埃兰人掳走。

people.name: Ishbi-Erra
people.known_for: Official of Ibbi-Sin who broke away and founded the First Dynasty of Isin.
people.known_for_zh: 伊比辛手下的官员，自立并建立伊辛第一王朝。

check.n: Wikipedia says Ishme-Dagan I died c. 1765 BC.

people.name: Lipit-Ishtar
people.known_for: King of Isin who issued one of the earliest Sumerian law codes.
people.known_for_zh: 伊辛国王，颁布了最早的苏美尔语法典之一。

people.name: Shamshi-Adad I
people.known_for: Amorite king who built a kingdom across Upper Mesopotamia from Assur to Mari.
people.known_for_zh: 阿摩利人国王，建立了从亚述城到马里的上美索不达米亚王国。

people.name: Rim-Sin I
people.known_for: King of Larsa who conquered Isin and ruled southern Mesopotamia until Hammurabi defeated him.
people.known_for_zh: 拉尔萨国王，征服伊辛，统治两河流域南部，最终被汉谟拉比击败。

people.name: Zimri-Lim
people.known_for: King of Mari whose palace archive of letters is a key source for the age of Hammurabi.
people.known_for_zh: 马里国王，他宫殿中的书信档案是研究汉谟拉比时代的重要史料。

people.name: Hammurabi
people.known_for: King of Babylon who united Mesopotamia and issued the famous law code carved on a stone stele.
people.known_for_zh: 巴比伦国王，统一两河流域，颁布刻在石碑上的著名法典。

people.name: Samsu-iluna
people.known_for: Son of Hammurabi who fought widespread revolts as southern Mesopotamia broke away.
people.known_for_zh: 汉谟拉比之子，在两河流域南部脱离控制时镇压各地叛乱。

people.name: Ammi-Saduqa
people.known_for: King of Babylon whose reign gave the Venus Tablet, an early record of planetary observation.
people.known_for_zh: 巴比伦国王，他在位时留下的“金星泥板”是早期的行星观测记录。

people.name: Anitta
people.known_for: King of Kussara who conquered Kanesh and wrote the oldest known text in the Hittite language.
people.known_for_zh: 库萨拉国王，征服卡内什，留下已知最早的赫梯语文献。

people.name: Hattusili I
people.known_for: Founder of the Hittite Old Kingdom who made Hattusa his capital and campaigned into Syria.
people.known_for_zh: 赫梯古王国的建立者，定都哈图沙，并向叙利亚扩张。

people.name: Mursili I
people.known_for: Hittite king who took Aleppo and sacked Babylon, ending the dynasty of Hammurabi.
people.known_for_zh: 赫梯国王，攻占阿勒颇并洗劫巴比伦，结束了汉谟拉比王朝。

check.n: Wikipedia says ruled perhaps c. 1465-1440 BC.
check.n_zh: 维基称约前1465年—前1440年在位。
维基称约前1245年—前1215年在位。

Assyria.name: Tukulti-Ninurta I
Assyria.name_zh: 图库尔蒂尼努尔塔一世

Assyria.name: Ninurta-apal-Ekur
Assyria.name_zh: 尼努尔塔阿帕尔埃库尔

people.name: Telipinu
people.known_for: Hittite king whose edict fixed the rules of royal succession after decades of murders.
people.known_for_zh: 赫梯国王，在多年宫廷仇杀之后颁布敕令，确立王位继承规则。

people.name: Kikkuli
people.known_for: Hurrian horse trainer from Mitanni whose chariot horse training manual is the oldest of its kind.
people.known_for_zh: 来自米坦尼的胡里安驯马师，他的战车马训练手册是同类著作中最古老的。

check.n: Only a floruit of c. 1400 BC is known; birth/death years are conjectural.
check.n_zh: 仅知其活跃于约公元前1400年，生卒年均为推测。

people.name: Tushratta
people.known_for: King of Mitanni whose letters to the pharaohs survive in the Amarna archive.
people.known_for_zh: 米坦尼国王，他写给法老的书信保存在阿马尔奈文书中。

people.name: Suppiluliuma I
people.known_for: Hittite king who destroyed Mitanni and made the Hittites the leading power of Syria.
people.known_for_zh: 赫梯国王，灭亡米坦尼，使赫梯成为叙利亚地区的霸主。

people.name: Burnaburiash II
people.known_for: Kassite king of Babylon who exchanged letters and gifts with Akhenaten.
people.known_for_zh: 巴比伦的加喜特国王，与埃及法老埃赫那吞互通书信和礼物。

people.name: Ashur-uballit I
people.known_for: King who freed Assyria from Mitanni and made it a great power.
people.known_for_zh: 使亚述摆脱米坦尼控制并成为大国的国王。

people.name: Rib-Hadda
people.known_for: King of Byblos who wrote more than 60 of the Amarna letters asking Egypt for help.
people.known_for_zh: 比布鲁斯国王，写下60多封阿马尔奈书信向埃及求援。

people.name: Mursili II
people.known_for: Hittite king known for his annals and his prayers during a great plague.
people.known_for_zh: 赫梯国王，以编年史和大瘟疫期间的祈祷文著称。

people.name: Muwatalli II
people.known_for: Hittite king who fought Ramesses II at the Battle of Kadesh.
people.known_for_zh: 赫梯国王，在卡迭石战役中与拉美西斯二世交战。

people.name: Hattusili III
people.known_for: Hittite king who made the earliest surviving peace treaty with Ramesses II.
people.known_for_zh: 赫梯国王，与拉美西斯二世签订了现存最早的和平条约。

people.name: Puduhepa
people.known_for: Hittite queen who co-signed treaties and corresponded with Egypt as an equal partner.
people.known_for_zh: 赫梯王后，与丈夫共同签署条约，以平等身份与埃及通信，是古代最有权势的女性之一。

people.name: Tukulti-Ninurta I
people.name_zh: 图库尔蒂尼努尔塔一世
people.known_for: Assyrian king who conquered Babylon and was celebrated in an epic poem.
people.known_for_zh: 亚述国王，攻陷巴比伦，一部史诗歌颂了他的功业。

people.name: Ammurapi
people.known_for: Last king of Ugarit, whose letters describe the Sea Peoples attacking just before the city fell.
people.known_for_zh: 乌加里特末代国王，他的书信描述了城市陷落前海上民族的侵袭。

Assyria.name: Tiglath-Pileser I
Assyria.name_zh: 提格拉特帕拉沙尔一世

people.name: Tiglath-Pileser I
people.name_zh: 提格拉特帕拉沙尔一世
people.known_for: Assyrian king who fought the Aramaeans and marched to the Mediterranean.
people.known_for_zh: 亚述国王，与阿拉米人作战，并进军至地中海沿岸。

people.name: Nebuchadnezzar I
people.known_for: Babylonian king who defeated Elam and brought the statue of Marduk back to Babylon.
people.known_for_zh: 巴比伦国王，击败埃兰，把马尔杜克神像迎回巴比伦。

people.name: Samuel
people.known_for: Prophet and last judge of Israel who, in the Bible, anointed Saul and David as kings.
people.known_for_zh: 以色列的先知和最后一位士师，据《圣经》记载他先后膏立扫罗和大卫为王。

people.name: Saul
people.known_for: First king of Israel in the Bible, who fought the Philistines.
people.known_for_zh: 《圣经》中以色列的第一位国王，与非利士人作战。

people.name: David
people.known_for: King of Israel who made Jerusalem his capital, remembered as the author of many Psalms.
people.known_for_zh: 以色列国王，定都耶路撒冷，相传是《诗篇》中许多诗歌的作者。

people.name: Solomon
people.known_for: Son of David, famed for his wisdom and for building the First Temple in Jerusalem.
people.known_for_zh: 大卫之子，以智慧著称，在耶路撒冷修建了第一圣殿。

people.name: Hiram I
people.known_for: King of Tyre who expanded Phoenician trade and supplied cedar for Solomon's Temple.
people.known_for_zh: 推罗国王，扩展腓尼基人的贸易，为所罗门圣殿提供雪松木。

people.name: Ahiram
people.known_for: King of Byblos whose sarcophagus bears one of the oldest Phoenician alphabet inscriptions.
people.known_for_zh: 比布鲁斯国王，他的石棺上刻有最古老的腓尼基字母铭文之一。

people.name: Rehoboam
people.known_for: Son of Solomon under whom the northern tribes broke away, leaving him king of Judah.
people.known_for_zh: 所罗门之子，在他统治时北方各支派分离，他只保有犹大王国。

people.name: Jeroboam I
people.known_for: Leader of the northern revolt who became the first king of the Kingdom of Israel.
people.known_for_zh: 领导北方各支派起事，成为北方以色列王国的第一位国王。

Assyria.name: Tukulti-Ninurta II
Assyria.name_zh: 图库尔蒂尼努尔塔二世

Assyria.name: Tiglath-Pileser III
Assyria.name_zh: 提格拉特帕拉沙尔三世

people.name: Ashurnasirpal II
people.known_for: Assyrian king who rebuilt Nimrud as his capital and decorated his palace with great stone reliefs.
people.known_for_zh: 亚述国王，重建尼姆鲁德为都城，在宫殿中装饰了巨大的石刻浮雕。

people.name: Shalmaneser III
people.known_for: Assyrian king who fought a Syrian coalition at Qarqar; his Black Obelisk shows King Jehu of Israel.
people.known_for_zh: 亚述国王，在卡尔卡尔与叙利亚联军作战，他的黑色方尖碑上刻有以色列王耶户的形象。

works.title: Black Obelisk of Shalmaneser III
works.title_zh: 撒缦以色三世黑色方尖碑

people.name: Ahab
people.known_for: King of Israel who fought at Qarqar against Assyria and is condemned in the Bible.
people.known_for_zh: 以色列国王，曾在卡尔卡尔抵抗亚述，在《圣经》中受到谴责。

people.name: Jezebel
people.known_for: Phoenician princess and queen of Israel who promoted the worship of Baal.
people.known_for_zh: 腓尼基公主、以色列王后，推崇巴力崇拜。

people.name: Elijah
people.known_for: Prophet who, in the Bible, opposed Ahab and Jezebel and the worship of Baal.
people.known_for_zh: 《圣经》中的先知，反对亚哈、耶洗别和巴力崇拜。

people.name: Hazael
people.known_for: King of Aram-Damascus who made his kingdom the strongest in Syria.
people.known_for_zh: 大马士革阿拉米王国国王，使其成为叙利亚最强的国家。

people.name: Shammuramat
people.known_for: Assyrian queen who may have ruled as regent for her son and inspired the legend of Semiramis.
people.known_for_zh: 亚述王后，可能曾为儿子摄政，是塞弥拉弥斯传说的原型。

people.name: Argishti I
people.known_for: King of Urartu who founded Erebuni, the site of today's Yerevan.
people.known_for_zh: 乌拉尔图国王，建立埃里布尼城，即今天的埃里温。

people.name: Amos
people.known_for: Hebrew prophet who preached social justice in the Kingdom of Israel.
people.known_for_zh: 希伯来先知，在北方以色列王国宣讲社会公正。

people.name: Tiglath-Pileser III
people.name_zh: 提格拉特帕拉沙尔三世
people.known_for: Assyrian king who created a standing army and turned conquered lands into provinces.
people.known_for_zh: 亚述国王，建立常备军，把被征服地区变为行省。

people.name: Isaiah
people.known_for: Prophet of Jerusalem in the Assyrian age whose book is one of the great texts of the Bible.
people.known_for_zh: 亚述时代耶路撒冷的先知，《以赛亚书》是《圣经》的重要经卷。

people.name: Midas
people.known_for: Historical king of Phrygia, remembered in Greek legend for his golden touch.
people.known_for_zh: 弗里吉亚的真实国王，在希腊传说中以“点石成金”闻名。

people.name: Sargon II
people.known_for: Assyrian king who deported the Israelites, defeated Urartu and built a new capital.
people.known_for_zh: 亚述国王，迁徙以色列人，击败乌拉尔图，修建新都杜尔沙鲁金。

people.name: Hezekiah
people.known_for: King of Judah who resisted Sennacherib and built a tunnel to bring water into Jerusalem.
people.known_for_zh: 犹大国王，抵抗辛那赫里布，开凿隧道把水引入耶路撒冷城内。

people.name: Sennacherib
people.known_for: Assyrian king who made Nineveh a magnificent capital and destroyed Babylon in 689 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 亚述国王，把尼尼微建成宏伟的都城，公元前689年摧毁巴比伦。

people.name: Naqi'a
people.known_for: Wife of Sennacherib and mother of Esarhaddon, one of the most powerful women in Assyria.
people.known_for_zh: 辛那赫里布之妻、以撒哈顿之母，是亚述最有权势的女性之一。

people.name: Esarhaddon
people.known_for: Assyrian king who rebuilt Babylon and conquered Egypt.
people.known_for_zh: 亚述国王，重建巴比伦，并征服埃及。

people.name: Ashurbanipal
people.known_for: Last great Assyrian king, who collected the royal library of clay tablets at Nineveh.
people.known_for_zh: 亚述最后一位强大的国王，在尼尼微收集泥板文献，建立王家图书馆。

check.n: Wikipedia gives reigned c. 635-585 BC; Croesus succeeded 560.
check.n_zh: 维基称约前635年—前585年在位。

people.name: Nabopolassar
people.known_for: Chaldean leader who freed Babylon from Assyria and, with the Medes, destroyed Nineveh in 612 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 迦勒底人首领，使巴比伦摆脱亚述统治，并与米底人一起于公元前612年攻灭尼尼微。

people.name: Josiah
people.known_for: King of Judah whose religious reform centred worship on the Temple in Jerusalem.
people.known_for_zh: 犹大国王，推行宗教改革，把崇拜集中于耶路撒冷圣殿。

people.name: Jeremiah
people.known_for: Prophet who warned of Jerusalem's fall to Babylon and lamented its destruction.
people.known_for_zh: 先知，预言耶路撒冷将被巴比伦攻陷，并为城市的毁灭哀叹。

people.name: Nebuchadnezzar II
people.known_for: Greatest Neo-Babylonian king, who rebuilt Babylon with the Ishtar Gate and took Jerusalem.
people.known_for_zh: 新巴比伦最强大的国王，重建巴比伦城和伊什塔尔门，攻陷耶路撒冷。

people.name: Zedekiah
people.known_for: Last king of Judah, whose revolt led Nebuchadnezzar to destroy Jerusalem in 586 BC.
people.known_for_zh: 犹大末代国王，他的反叛导致尼布甲尼撒于公元前586年摧毁耶路撒冷。

people.name: Ezekiel
people.known_for: Prophet among the exiles in Babylon whose visions shaped Jewish thought.
people.known_for_zh: 被掳到巴比伦的先知，他的异象对犹太思想影响深远。

people.name: Croesus
people.known_for: Fabulously rich king of Lydia, overthrown by Cyrus the Great.
people.known_for_zh: 吕底亚国王，以富有著称，后被居鲁士大帝推翻。

people.name: Adad-guppi
people.known_for: Mother of Nabonidus and devotee of the moon god Sin, whose long life is told in her own inscription.
people.known_for_zh: 那波尼德之母，月神辛的虔诚信徒，她的铭文记述了自己漫长的一生。

people.name: Nabonidus
people.known_for: Last king of Babylon, who restored old temples and spent years in Arabia.
people.known_for_zh: 新巴比伦末代国王，热衷修复古代神庙，曾在阿拉伯半岛居住多年。

people.name: Belshazzar
people.known_for: Son of Nabonidus who governed Babylon in his absence, known from the writing on the wall in the Bible.
people.known_for_zh: 那波尼德之子，在父亲外出时治理巴比伦，《圣经》中“墙上的字”故事与他有关。

people.name: Ennigaldi-Nanna
people.known_for: Daughter of Nabonidus and priestess at Ur, sometimes called the first museum curator.
people.known_for_zh: 那波尼德之女、乌尔的女祭司，被认为建立了最早的“博物馆”。

people.name: Sheshbazzar
people.known_for: Prince of Judah who led the first exiles home from Babylon under Cyrus and laid the Temple's foundation.
people.known_for_zh: 犹大的王子，在居鲁士准许下率领第一批流亡者从巴比伦返回，奠定圣殿的根基。

people.name: Zerubbabel
people.known_for: Governor of Judah who led returning exiles and began rebuilding the Temple.
people.known_for_zh: 犹大省长，带领归国的犹太人开始重建圣殿。

people.name: Haggai
people.known_for: Prophet who urged the returned exiles to finish the Second Temple.
people.known_for_zh: 先知，敦促归国的犹太人完成第二圣殿的建造。

people.name: Zechariah
people.known_for: Prophet who, with Haggai, encouraged the rebuilding of the Temple.
people.known_for_zh: 先知，与哈该一起鼓励重建圣殿。

people.name: Malachi
people.known_for: Prophet whose book closes the prophetic books of the Christian Old Testament.
people.known_for_zh: 先知，《玛拉基书》是基督教《旧约》先知书的最后一卷。

people.name: Ezra
people.known_for: Scribe who brought the Law of Moses from Babylon and reformed Jewish life in Jerusalem.
people.known_for_zh: 文士，从巴比伦带回摩西律法，整顿耶路撒冷犹太人的宗教生活。

people.name: Nehemiah
people.known_for: Cupbearer of Artaxerxes I who became governor of Judah and rebuilt the walls of Jerusalem.
people.known_for_zh: 阿尔塔薛西斯一世的司酒官，后任犹大省长，重修耶路撒冷城墙。

people.name: Mausolus
people.known_for: Persian satrap of Caria whose huge tomb gave the word mausoleum.
people.known_for_zh: 波斯卡里亚行省总督，他的巨大陵墓是“陵墓”一词的来源，列为古代世界七大奇迹之一。

people.name: Kidinnu
people.known_for: Babylonian astronomer named by Greek writers for his precise calculations of the moon.
people.known_for_zh: 巴比伦天文学家，希腊作家称赞他对月亮运行的精确计算。

people.name: Berossus
people.known_for: Babylonian priest who wrote a history of Babylon in Greek.
people.known_for_zh: 巴比伦祭司，用希腊文写成一部巴比伦史。

people.name: Attalus I
people.known_for: King of Pergamon who defeated the Galatians and allied with Rome.
people.known_for_zh: 帕加马国王，击败加拉太人，与罗马结盟。

people.name: Antiochus III the Great
people.known_for: Seleucid king who restored the empire in the east but was defeated by Rome.
people.known_for_zh: 塞琉古国王，在东方恢复了帝国疆域，但后来被罗马击败。

people.name: Eumenes II
people.known_for: King of Pergamon who built the Great Altar and a library to rival Alexandria's.
people.known_for_zh: 帕加马国王，修建宙斯大祭坛和可与亚历山大图书馆相比的图书馆。

people.name: Crates of Mallus
people.known_for: Head of the Pergamon library, a Homer scholar who built an early globe of the Earth.
people.known_for_zh: 帕加马图书馆的主持人，研究荷马史诗，制作了早期的地球仪。

people.name: Antiochus IV Epiphanes
people.known_for: Seleucid king whose attack on Jewish religion provoked the Maccabean revolt.
people.known_for_zh: 塞琉古国王，他对犹太教的迫害引发了马加比起义。

people.name: Judas Maccabeus
people.known_for: Leader of the Jewish revolt who retook Jerusalem and rededicated the Temple, remembered at Hanukkah.
people.known_for_zh: 犹太起义领袖，收复耶路撒冷并重新洁净圣殿，光明节即纪念此事。

people.name: Seleucus of Seleucia
people.known_for: Astronomer who supported the idea that the Earth moves around the Sun.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家，支持地球绕太阳运行的日心说。

people.name: Alexander Jannaeus
people.known_for: Hasmonean king who expanded Judea to its greatest extent.
people.known_for_zh: 哈斯蒙尼王朝国王，使犹太王国疆域达到最大。

people.name: Salome Alexandra
people.known_for: Queen of Judea whose peaceful reign was later remembered as a golden age.
people.known_for_zh: 犹太女王，她在位时局势安定，后人视为黄金时代。

people.name: Tigranes the Great
people.known_for: King of Armenia who built a short-lived empire from the Caspian to Syria.
people.known_for_zh: 亚美尼亚国王，一度建立从里海到叙利亚的帝国。

Judea.name: Herod Archelaus
Judea.note: Ethnarch of Judea, deposed by Rome.
Judea.note_zh: 犹太地区分封王，后被罗马废黜。

people.name: Herod the Great
people.known_for: Client king of Judea under Rome who rebuilt the Temple in Jerusalem and built Masada and Caesarea.
people.known_for_zh: 罗马扶植的犹太国王，重建耶路撒冷圣殿，修建马萨达要塞和凯撒利亚港。

people.name: Hillel the Elder
people.known_for: Jewish sage whose gentle teaching and golden rule shaped rabbinic Judaism.
people.known_for_zh: 犹太贤哲，他温和的教导和“己所不欲，勿施于人”的格言深刻影响了拉比犹太教。

people.name: Aretas IV
people.known_for: King of the Nabataeans under whom Petra reached its greatest splendour.
people.known_for_zh: 纳巴泰国王，在他统治时佩特拉城达到最繁荣的时期。

people.name: John the Baptist
people.known_for: Jewish preacher who baptised people in the Jordan, including Jesus.
people.known_for_zh: 犹太传道者，在约旦河为人施洗，耶稣也曾受他的洗礼。

people.name: Jesus
people.known_for: Jewish preacher from Galilee, crucified in Jerusalem, whose followers founded Christianity.
people.known_for_zh: 来自加利利的犹太传道者，在耶路撒冷被钉十字架，他的追随者创立了基督教。

people.name: Johanan ben Zakkai
people.known_for: Sage who founded the academy at Yavne and helped Judaism survive the destruction of the Temple.
people.known_for_zh: 犹太贤哲，在雅夫内创办学院，使犹太教在圣殿被毁后得以延续。

check.n: Life dates are traditional and very uncertain (1st century CE).
check.n_zh: 生卒年为传统说法，极不确定（公元1世纪）。

people.name: Ignatius of Antioch
people.known_for: Early bishop of Antioch whose letters written on his way to martyrdom shaped church order.
people.known_for_zh: 早期安条克主教，他在赴死途中写下的书信对教会制度影响很大。

people.name: Rabbi Akiva
people.known_for: Leading rabbi of his age who organised Jewish oral law and supported the Bar Kokhba revolt.
people.known_for_zh: 当时最重要的拉比，整理犹太口传律法，支持巴尔·科赫巴起义。

people.name: Simon bar Kokhba
people.known_for: Leader of the last great Jewish revolt against Rome (132 to 136).
people.known_for_zh: 领导了犹太人反抗罗马的最后一次大起义（132年至136年）。

people.name: Lucian of Samosata
people.known_for: Syrian satirist writing in Greek, whose True History is an early tale of travel to the moon.
people.known_for_zh: 用希腊文写作的叙利亚讽刺作家，他的《真实的故事》是早期描写登月旅行的作品。

people.name: Tatian
people.known_for: Syrian Christian writer who combined the four Gospels into one narrative.
people.known_for_zh: 叙利亚基督教作家，把四部福音书合编为一部连贯的叙述。

people.name: Bardaisan
people.known_for: Philosopher and poet of Edessa, one of the first great writers in Syriac.
people.known_for_zh: 埃德萨的哲学家和诗人，是最早的重要叙利亚语作家之一。

works.title: Book of the Laws of Countries

people.name: Judah ha-Nasi
people.known_for: Patriarch of the Jews who compiled the Mishnah, the first written code of Jewish oral law.
people.known_for_zh: 犹太族长，编成《密释纳》，这是第一部成文的犹太口传律法。

people.name: Odaenathus
people.known_for: Ruler of Palmyra who defeated the Persians and defended Rome's eastern provinces.
people.known_for_zh: 巴尔米拉统治者，击败波斯人，保卫罗马的东方行省。

people.name: Ephrem the Syrian
people.known_for: Deacon and hymn writer, the greatest poet of the Syriac language.
people.known_for_zh: 执事和圣诗作者，是叙利亚语最伟大的诗人。

people.name: Libanius
people.known_for: Pagan teacher of rhetoric at Antioch whose students included John Chrysostom.
people.known_for_zh: 安条克的异教修辞学教师，学生中有约翰·克里索斯托。

people.name: Nestorius
people.known_for: Archbishop of Constantinople condemned at Ephesus in 431; his followers took the Church of the East to Tang China as Jingjiao.
people.known_for_zh: 君士坦丁堡大主教，431年在以弗所会议上被判为异端，其教派后来传入唐朝，称为景教。

people.name: Simeon Stylites
people.known_for: Syrian ascetic who lived for 37 years on top of a pillar near Aleppo.
people.known_for_zh: 叙利亚苦修者，在阿勒颇附近的一根石柱顶上生活了37年。

people.name: Romanos the Melodist
people.known_for: Syrian-born hymn writer, the greatest poet of the Byzantine church.
people.known_for_zh: 生于叙利亚的圣诗作者，是拜占庭教会最伟大的诗人。

people.name: Isidore of Miletus
people.known_for: Geometer and co-architect of the Hagia Sophia.
people.known_for_zh: 几何学家，圣索菲亚大教堂的设计者之一。

people.name: Imru' al-Qais
people.known_for: Pre-Islamic Arab poet whose ode is the most famous of the Hanging Poems.
people.known_for_zh: 伊斯兰教以前的阿拉伯诗人，他的长诗是《悬诗》中最著名的一首。

people.name: Abraha
people.known_for: Aksumite ruler of Yemen who built a great church at Sana'a and marched on Mecca.
people.known_for_zh: 统治也门的阿克苏姆将领，在萨那建造大教堂，并率军进攻麦加。

people.name: Antarah ibn Shaddad
people.known_for: Pre-Islamic warrior poet, born to an enslaved mother, a hero of later Arab romance.
people.known_for_zh: 伊斯兰教以前的武士诗人，母亲是女奴，后来成为阿拉伯传奇故事中的英雄。

people.name: Khadija bint Khuwaylid
people.known_for: Merchant of Mecca, first wife of Muhammad and the first person to accept Islam.
people.known_for_zh: 麦加女商人，穆罕默德的第一位妻子，也是第一个皈依伊斯兰教的人。

people.name: Muhammad
people.known_for: Prophet of Islam who received the Quran, founded the Muslim community at Medina and united Arabia.
people.known_for_zh: 伊斯兰教的先知，传布《古兰经》，在麦地那建立穆斯林社团，统一了阿拉伯半岛。

people.name: Heraclius
people.known_for: Emperor who defeated Persia in 628 but then lost Syria and Egypt to the Arabs.
people.known_for_zh: 东罗马皇帝，628年战胜波斯，但随后把叙利亚和埃及丢给了阿拉伯人。

Sasanian Empire.name: Yazdegerd III
Sasanian Empire.note: Last Sasanian king; his son Peroz fled to Tang China.
Sasanian Empire.note_zh: 萨珊末代君主，其子卑路斯逃往唐朝。

people.name: Abu Bakr
people.known_for: Close companion of Muhammad and first caliph, who reunited Arabia in the Ridda wars.
people.known_for_zh: 穆罕默德的亲密伙伴，第一任哈里发，通过叛教战争重新统一阿拉伯半岛。

people.name: Umar
people.known_for: Second caliph, under whom the Arabs conquered Syria, Iraq, Egypt and Persia.
people.known_for_zh: 第二任哈里发，在他治下阿拉伯人征服了叙利亚、伊拉克、埃及和波斯。

people.name: Uthman
people.known_for: Third caliph, who had the standard text of the Quran compiled.
people.known_for_zh: 第三任哈里发，主持编定了《古兰经》的标准文本。

people.name: Ali
people.known_for: Cousin and son-in-law of Muhammad and fourth caliph, revered by Shia Muslims as the first imam.
people.known_for_zh: 穆罕默德的堂弟和女婿，第四任哈里发，被什叶派尊为第一任伊玛目。

people.name: Fatimah
people.known_for: Daughter of Muhammad and wife of Ali, honoured by all Muslims.
people.known_for_zh: 穆罕默德的女儿、阿里的妻子，受到所有穆斯林的尊敬。

people.name: Khalid ibn al-Walid
people.known_for: Arab general called the Sword of God, victor at the Battle of Yarmouk in 636.
people.known_for_zh: 阿拉伯名将，号称“真主之剑”，636年在雅穆克战役中获胜。

people.name: Abu Ubayda ibn al-Jarrah
people.known_for: Companion of Muhammad who commanded the conquest of Syria.
people.known_for_zh: 穆罕默德的门弟子，指挥征服叙利亚的战争。

people.name: Sa'd ibn Abi Waqqas
people.known_for: Commander who defeated the Persians at Qadisiyya and took Ctesiphon; legend links him to Islam in China.
people.known_for_zh: 击败波斯人于卡迪西亚并攻占泰西封的将领，传说他曾来华传教。

people.name: Bilal ibn Rabah
people.known_for: Freed Ethiopian slave who became the first muezzin of Islam.
people.known_for_zh: 获释的埃塞俄比亚奴隶，成为伊斯兰教的第一位宣礼员。

people.name: Salman the Persian
people.known_for: Persian convert and companion of Muhammad, later governor of Ctesiphon.
people.known_for_zh: 皈依伊斯兰教的波斯人，穆罕默德的门弟子，后来任泰西封总督。

people.name: Zayd ibn Thabit
people.known_for: Scribe of Muhammad who led the compilation of the Quran.
people.known_for_zh: 穆罕默德的书记员，主持汇编《古兰经》。

people.name: Aisha
people.known_for: Wife of Muhammad and a major source of hadith, who fought Ali at the Battle of the Camel.
people.known_for_zh: 穆罕默德的妻子，是圣训的重要传述者，曾在骆驼之战中与阿里对抗。

people.name: Abu Hurayrah
people.known_for: Companion of Muhammad who transmitted more hadith than anyone else.
people.known_for_zh: 穆罕默德的门弟子，传述的圣训数量最多。

people.name: Mu'awiya I
people.known_for: Governor of Syria who founded the Umayyad dynasty and ruled from Damascus.
people.known_for_zh: 叙利亚总督，建立倭马亚王朝，定都大马士革。

people.name: Husayn ibn Ali
people.known_for: Grandson of Muhammad killed at Karbala, whose death is mourned by Shia Muslims at Ashura.
people.known_for_zh: 穆罕默德的外孙，在卡尔巴拉遇难，什叶派每年在阿舒拉节哀悼他。

people.name: Al-Akhtal
people.known_for: Christian Arab poet at the Umayyad court, famous for his panegyrics.
people.known_for_zh: 倭马亚宫廷中的基督徒阿拉伯诗人，以颂诗著称。

people.name: Al-Farazdaq
people.known_for: Poet of Basra famous for his long verse duel with Jarir.
people.known_for_zh: 巴士拉诗人，与哲利尔长期以诗相互讥讽。

people.name: Jarir ibn Atiyya
people.known_for: Satirical poet, rival of al-Farazdaq, one of the great poets of the Umayyad age.
people.known_for_zh: 讽刺诗人，法拉兹达格的对手，倭马亚时代的大诗人之一。

people.name: Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan
people.known_for: Caliph who made Arabic the language of government, minted Islamic coins and built the Dome of the Rock.
people.known_for_zh: 哈里发，把阿拉伯语定为官方语言，铸造伊斯兰钱币，修建圆顶清真寺。

people.name: Al-Hajjaj ibn Yusuf
people.known_for: Feared governor of Iraq who crushed revolts and sent armies to Central Asia and Sindh.
people.known_for_zh: 令人畏惧的伊拉克总督，镇压叛乱，派军远征中亚和信德。

people.name: Hasan al-Basri
people.known_for: Preacher of Basra whose piety made him a founding figure of Sufism.
people.known_for_zh: 巴士拉的宣教者，以虔诚著称，被视为苏非派的先驱。

people.name: John of Damascus
people.known_for: Christian theologian and Umayyad official who defended the use of icons.
people.known_for_zh: 基督教神学家，曾任倭马亚官员，为圣像崇拜辩护。

people.name: Umar II
people.known_for: Pious Umayyad caliph who treated non-Arab Muslims as equals.
people.known_for_zh: 虔诚的倭马亚哈里发，主张非阿拉伯穆斯林与阿拉伯人平等。

people.name: Leo III the Isaurian
people.known_for: Byzantine emperor who broke the Arab siege of Constantinople in 718 and began Iconoclasm.
people.known_for_zh: 拜占庭皇帝，718年击退阿拉伯人对君士坦丁堡的围攻，并发起毁坏圣像运动。

people.name: Zayd ibn Ali
people.known_for: Great-grandson of Ali who led a revolt at Kufa; the Zaydi branch of Shia Islam is named after him.
people.known_for_zh: 阿里的曾孙，在库法起义，什叶派的宰德派以他命名。

people.name: Wasil ibn Ata
people.known_for: Theologian of Basra who founded the rationalist Mu'tazila school.
people.known_for_zh: 巴士拉的神学家，创立理性主义的穆尔太齐赖派。

Abbasid Caliphate.name: al-Muti
Abbasid Caliphate.note: From 945 the caliphs were under Buyid control.
Abbasid Caliphate.note_zh: 945年起哈里发受布韦希王朝控制。

people.name: Ja'far al-Sadiq
people.known_for: Sixth Shia imam and teacher of law whose school became the basis of Twelver Shia law.
people.known_for_zh: 什叶派第六任伊玛目，他的法学成为十二伊玛目派教法的基础。

people.name: Abu Hanifa
people.known_for: Jurist of Kufa who founded the Hanafi school, the most widespread school of Sunni law.
people.known_for_zh: 库法的法学家，创立哈乃斐学派，这是流传最广的逊尼派法学派。

people.name: Al-Mansur
people.known_for: Second Abbasid caliph who founded Baghdad as the round city in 762.
people.known_for_zh: 阿拔斯王朝第二任哈里发，762年兴建圆形的巴格达城。

people.name: Rabia of Basra
people.known_for: Woman mystic of Basra who taught the selfless love of God, a founding saint of Sufism.
people.known_for_zh: 巴士拉的女神秘主义者，宣扬对真主无私的爱，是苏非派的先驱圣徒。

people.name: Malik ibn Anas
people.known_for: Jurist of Medina who founded the Maliki school of law.
people.known_for_zh: 麦地那的法学家，创立马立克学派。

people.name: Harun al-Rashid
people.known_for: Caliph at the height of Abbasid power, remembered in the Thousand and One Nights.
people.known_for_zh: 阿拔斯王朝极盛时期的哈里发，《一千零一夜》中多有他的故事。

people.name: Abu Nuwas
people.known_for: Witty poet of Baghdad famous for his wine songs.
people.known_for_zh: 巴格达诙谐的诗人，以咏酒诗著称。

people.name: Al-Shafi'i
people.known_for: Jurist who laid down the principles of Islamic jurisprudence and founded the Shafi'i school.
people.known_for_zh: 法学家，奠定伊斯兰法学的基本原则，创立沙斐仪学派。

people.name: Al-Ma'mun
people.known_for: Caliph who sponsored the House of Wisdom and the translation of Greek science into Arabic.
people.known_for_zh: 哈里发，资助智慧宫，推动把希腊科学著作译成阿拉伯文。

people.name: Al-Jahiz
people.known_for: Prose writer of Basra whose Book of Animals is a masterpiece of Arabic literature.
people.known_for_zh: 巴士拉的散文家，他的《动物志》是阿拉伯文学名著。

people.name: Ahmad ibn Hanbal
people.known_for: Traditionist who resisted the caliph's inquisition and founded the Hanbali school.
people.known_for_zh: 圣训学家，抵制哈里发的宗教审查，创立罕百里学派。

works.title: Musnad Ahmad ibn Hanbal
works.title_zh: 罕百勒穆斯奈德圣训集

people.name: Al-Khwarizmi
people.known_for: Mathematician of the House of Wisdom whose book on equations gave us the word algebra.
people.known_for_zh: 智慧宫的数学家，他论方程的著作是“代数学”一词的来源。

works.title: The Compendious Book on Calculation by Completion and Balancing

people.name: Al-Kindi
people.known_for: The first great philosopher writing in Arabic, who joined Greek philosophy with Islam.
people.known_for_zh: 第一位用阿拉伯文写作的大哲学家，致力于融合希腊哲学和伊斯兰教。

people.name: Hunayn ibn Ishaq
people.known_for: Christian physician who translated Galen and other Greek works into Arabic and Syriac.
people.known_for_zh: 基督徒医生，把盖伦等人的希腊著作译成阿拉伯文和叙利亚文。

people.name: Ibn Khordadbeh
people.known_for: Geographer whose Book of Roads and Kingdoms describes the sea route to China.
people.known_for_zh: 地理学家，他的《道里邦国志》记述了通往中国的海路。

people.name: Thabit ibn Qurra
people.known_for: Sabian mathematician and astronomer who translated Euclid and Ptolemy.
people.known_for_zh: 萨比教徒数学家和天文学家，翻译了欧几里得和托勒密的著作。

people.name: Al-Tabari
people.known_for: Historian and Quran scholar whose History of the Prophets and Kings is a basic source of early Islam.
people.known_for_zh: 历史学家和经注学家，他的《历代先知和帝王史》是早期伊斯兰史的基本史料。

works.title: History of the Prophets and Kings

people.name: Al-Battani
people.known_for: Astronomer of Raqqa who measured the solar year with great accuracy.
people.known_for_zh: 拉卡的天文学家，精确测定了太阳年的长度。

people.name: Mansur al-Hallaj
people.known_for: Sufi mystic executed in Baghdad for saying "I am the Truth".
people.known_for_zh: 苏非派神秘主义者，因宣称“我即真理”在巴格达被处死。

people.name: Al-Farabi
people.known_for: Philosopher called the Second Teacher after Aristotle, author of The Virtuous City.
people.known_for_zh: 被称为仅次于亚里士多德的“第二导师”的哲学家，著有《美德城邦》。

people.name: Al-Mas'udi
people.known_for: Historian and traveller whose Meadows of Gold surveys the known world, including China.
people.known_for_zh: 历史学家和旅行家，他的《黄金草原》概述了当时已知的世界，包括中国。

people.name: Al-Mutanabbi
people.known_for: Poet at the court of Sayf al-Dawla in Aleppo, often called the greatest Arab poet.
people.known_for_zh: 阿勒颇赛夫·道莱宫廷诗人，常被誉为最伟大的阿拉伯诗人。

people.name: Al-Ma'arri
people.known_for: Blind poet and sceptical thinker of Syria.
people.known_for_zh: 叙利亚的盲诗人和怀疑论思想家。

Kingdom of Jerusalem.name: Godfrey of Bouillon
Kingdom of Jerusalem.note: Took the title Defender of the Holy Sepulchre, not king.
Kingdom of Jerusalem.note_zh: 称“圣墓守护者”，未称国王。

people.name: Tughril
people.known_for: Founder of the Seljuk Empire who entered Baghdad in 1055 and was named sultan by the caliph.
people.known_for_zh: 塞尔柱帝国的建立者，1055年进入巴格达，被哈里发封为苏丹。

people.name: Arwa al-Sulayhi
people.known_for: Queen of Yemen who ruled for decades in her own name.
people.known_for_zh: 也门女王，以自己的名义统治数十年。

people.name: Alexios I Komnenos
people.known_for: Byzantine emperor whose appeal to the West helped launch the First Crusade.
people.known_for_zh: 拜占庭皇帝，他向西方求援促成了第一次十字军东征。

people.name: Abdul Qadir Gilani
people.name_zh: 阿卜杜勒·卡迪尔·吉拉尼
people.known_for: Preacher of Baghdad and founder of the Qadiriyya, one of the largest Sufi orders.
people.known_for_zh: 巴格达的宣教者，创立卡迪里教团，这是最大的苏非教团之一。

people.name: Imad al-Din Zengi
people.known_for: Atabeg of Mosul and Aleppo whose capture of Edessa in 1144 set off the Second Crusade.
people.known_for_zh: 摩苏尔和阿勒颇的统治者，1144年攻占埃德萨，引发第二次十字军东征。

people.name: Usama ibn Munqidh
people.known_for: Syrian knight and poet whose memoirs give a lively picture of the crusaders.
people.known_for_zh: 叙利亚骑士和诗人，他的回忆录生动描绘了十字军。

people.name: Melisende
people.known_for: Queen of Jerusalem who ruled with her husband and son and patronised the arts.
people.known_for_zh: 耶路撒冷女王，先后与丈夫和儿子共治，赞助艺术。

people.name: Ibn Asakir
people.known_for: Historian whose huge History of Damascus is a key source for Syria.
people.known_for_zh: 历史学家，他卷帙浩繁的《大马士革史》是研究叙利亚的重要史料。

people.name: Nur ad-Din
people.known_for: Ruler of Syria who united Aleppo and Damascus against the crusaders.
people.known_for_zh: 叙利亚统治者，统一阿勒颇和大马士革，共同对抗十字军。

people.name: William of Tyre
people.known_for: Archbishop of Tyre and chronicler of the crusader kingdom.
people.known_for_zh: 提尔大主教，十字军王国的编年史家。

people.name: Ismail al-Jazari
people.known_for: Engineer whose book of ingenious devices describes water clocks and automata.
people.known_for_zh: 工程师，他的《精巧机械装置知识之书》描述了水钟和自动机械。

works.title: The Book of Knowledge of Ingenious Mechanical Devices
works.title_zh: 精巧机械装置知识之书

people.name: Shahab al-Din Suhrawardi
people.known_for: Philosopher of illumination, executed in Aleppo.
people.known_for_zh: 光照学派哲学家，在阿勒颇被处死。

people.name: Baldwin IV of Jerusalem
people.known_for: Leper king of Jerusalem who defeated Saladin at Montgisard in 1177.
people.known_for_zh: 患麻风病的耶路撒冷国王，1177年在蒙吉萨击败萨拉丁。

people.name: Ali ibn al-Athir
people.known_for: Historian of Mosul whose Complete History covers the crusades and the Mongols.
people.known_for_zh: 摩苏尔的历史学家，他的《全史》记述了十字军和蒙古入侵。

people.name: Ibn Arabi
people.known_for: Andalusian mystic who settled in Damascus, the most influential Sufi thinker.
people.known_for_zh: 定居大马士革的安达卢斯神秘主义者，是影响最大的苏非思想家。

people.name: Yaqut al-Hamawi
people.known_for: Geographer whose Dictionary of Countries describes the whole Islamic world.
people.known_for_zh: 地理学家，他的《地名辞典》记述了整个伊斯兰世界。

people.name: Kayqubad I
people.known_for: Seljuk sultan of Rum under whom Konya reached its greatest prosperity.
people.known_for_zh: 罗姆苏丹国苏丹，在他统治时科尼亚达到极盛。

people.name: Rumi
people.known_for: Persian Sufi poet of Konya whose Masnavi is loved across the world; the whirling dervishes follow him.
people.known_for_zh: 在科尼亚生活的波斯苏非诗人，他的《玛斯纳维》闻名世界，旋转舞托钵僧团奉他为祖师。

Ottoman Empire.name: Mehmed I
Ottoman Empire.note: Sole sultan after the civil war of 1402 to 1413.
Ottoman Empire.note_zh: 1402年至1413年内战之后成为唯一的苏丹。

people.name: Hulagu Khan
people.known_for: Grandson of Genghis Khan who sacked Baghdad in 1258 and founded the Ilkhanate.
people.known_for_zh: 成吉思汗之孙，1258年攻陷巴格达，建立伊儿汗国。

people.name: Nasreddin
people.known_for: Anatolian wise fool whose funny stories are told from the Balkans to Xinjiang, where he is called Afanti.
people.known_for_zh: 安纳托利亚的智者，他的笑话从巴尔干流传到新疆，中国称他为阿凡提。

people.name: Haji Bektash Veli
people.known_for: Mystic of Anatolia whose teachings gave rise to the Bektashi order.
people.known_for_zh: 安纳托利亚的神秘主义者，他的教导形成了贝克塔什教团。

people.name: Bar Hebraeus
people.known_for: Syriac Orthodox bishop and polymath who wrote histories, theology and science.
people.known_for_zh: 叙利亚正教会主教和博学家，著有历史、神学和科学著作。

people.name: Yunus Emre
people.known_for: Sufi poet who first wrote great poetry in plain Turkish.
people.known_for_zh: 苏非派诗人，最早用通俗土耳其语写出伟大的诗篇。

people.name: Osman I
people.known_for: Founder of the Ottoman state in north-western Anatolia.
people.known_for_zh: 在安纳托利亚西北部建立奥斯曼国家的开国君主。

people.name: Ibn Taymiyya
people.known_for: Hanbali theologian of Damascus who called for a return to the Quran and early practice.
people.known_for_zh: 大马士革的罕百里派神学家，主张回归《古兰经》和早期圣训。

people.name: Abu'l-Fida
people.known_for: Prince of Hama, historian and geographer.
people.known_for_zh: 哈马的统治者，历史学家和地理学家。

people.name: Orhan
people.known_for: Second Ottoman ruler who took Bursa as capital and crossed into Europe.
people.known_for_zh: 奥斯曼第二任君主，以布尔萨为都城，并越过海峡进入欧洲。

people.name: Ibn Qayyim al-Jawziyya
people.known_for: Student of Ibn Taymiyya and a prolific writer on law and spirituality.
people.known_for_zh: 伊本·泰米叶的学生，在教法和灵修方面著述丰富。

people.name: Ibn Kathir
people.known_for: Historian and Quran commentator of Damascus.
people.known_for_zh: 大马士革的历史学家和《古兰经》注释家。

people.name: Ibn al-Shatir
people.known_for: Astronomer of the Umayyad Mosque whose planetary models anticipated those of Copernicus.
people.known_for_zh: 大马士革倭马亚清真寺的天文学家，他的行星模型与后来哥白尼的模型相似。

people.name: Bayezid I
people.known_for: Ottoman sultan called the Thunderbolt, defeated and captured by Timur at Ankara in 1402.
people.known_for_zh: 号称“雷霆”的奥斯曼苏丹，1402年在安卡拉战役中被帖木儿击败俘虏。

Oman.name: Nasir bin Murshid
Oman.note: Founded the Yaruba dynasty and drove out the Portuguese.
Oman.note_zh: 建立亚里巴王朝，驱逐葡萄牙人。

check.n: Wikipedia gives 1783 – 1786; sources differ, the map keeps the dates it had.
check.n_zh: 维基百科作1783年—1786年；诸说不一，地图暂沿用原年代。

Emirate of Diriyah.name: Abdulaziz bin Muhammad
Emirate of Diriyah.name_zh: 阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·本·穆罕默德

Emirate of Diriyah.name: Saud bin Abdulaziz
Emirate of Diriyah.name_zh: 沙特·本·阿卜杜勒阿齐兹

people.name: Piri Reis
people.known_for: Ottoman admiral and cartographer whose 1513 world map shows the coast of America.
people.known_for_zh: 奥斯曼海军将领和制图家，他1513年绘制的世界地图描绘了美洲海岸。

people.name: Fuzuli
people.known_for: Poet of Baghdad who wrote in Turkish, Persian and Arabic, author of Layla and Majnun.
people.known_for_zh: 巴格达诗人，用土耳其语、波斯语和阿拉伯语写作，著有《蕾莉与马杰农》。
states: Emirate of the White Sheep Turks

people.name: Joseph Karo
people.known_for: Rabbi of Safed whose Shulchan Aruch became the standard code of Jewish law.
people.known_for_zh: 采法特的拉比，他编写的《布就之席》成为犹太律法的标准法典。

people.name: Mimar Sinan
people.known_for: Chief architect of the Ottoman Empire, builder of the Süleymaniye and Selimiye mosques.
people.known_for_zh: 奥斯曼帝国总建筑师，设计了苏莱曼尼耶清真寺和塞利米耶清真寺。

people.name: Suleiman the Magnificent
people.known_for: Sultan at the height of Ottoman power, known in Turkey as the Lawgiver.
people.known_for_zh: 奥斯曼帝国极盛时期的苏丹，在土耳其被称为“立法者”。

people.name: Pargalı Ibrahim Pasha
people.name_zh: 帕尔加勒·易卜拉欣帕夏
people.known_for: Grand vizier and friend of Suleiman, executed at the height of his power.
people.known_for_zh: 苏莱曼的大维齐尔和挚友，在权力巅峰时被处死。

people.name: Hurrem Sultan
people.known_for: Wife of Suleiman, who began the age of powerful women in the Ottoman palace.
people.known_for_zh: 苏莱曼的妻子，开启了奥斯曼后宫女性干政的时代。

people.name: Sokollu Mehmed Pasha
people.known_for: Grand vizier under three sultans who planned a Suez canal.
people.known_for_zh: 历仕三位苏丹的大维齐尔，曾计划开凿苏伊士运河。

people.name: Matrakçı Nasuh
people.known_for: Bosnian-born polymath famous for his bird's-eye miniature paintings of cities.
people.known_for_zh: 出生于波斯尼亚的博学家，以鸟瞰式的城市细密画著称。

people.name: Taqi al-Din
people.known_for: Astronomer who built the Istanbul observatory and wrote on mechanical clocks.
people.known_for_zh: 天文学家，建立伊斯坦布尔天文台，并著有机械钟的论著。

people.name: Bâkî
people.known_for: Leading Ottoman court poet of Suleiman's age.
people.known_for_zh: 苏莱曼时代最重要的奥斯曼宫廷诗人。

people.name: Isaac Luria
people.known_for: Mystic of Safed whose teaching reshaped the Kabbalah.
people.known_for_zh: 采法特的神秘主义者，他的学说改变了卡巴拉。

people.name: Fakhr al-Din II
people.known_for: Druze emir who built an autonomous state in Mount Lebanon.
people.known_for_zh: 德鲁兹派埃米尔，在黎巴嫩山区建立自治政权。

people.name: Kösem Sultan
people.known_for: Mother of two sultans who effectively governed the empire as regent.
people.known_for_zh: 两位苏丹的母亲，以摄政身份实际掌控帝国。

people.name: Katip Çelebi
people.known_for: Ottoman scholar who wrote a great bibliography and a world geography.
people.known_for_zh: 奥斯曼学者，编写了大型书目和世界地理著作。

people.name: Evliya Çelebi
people.known_for: Traveller who described the Ottoman lands in a ten-volume Book of Travels.
people.known_for_zh: 旅行家，用十卷本《游记》描述了奥斯曼帝国各地。

people.name: Sabbatai Zevi
people.known_for: Rabbi of Smyrna who claimed to be the Messiah and then converted to Islam.
people.known_for_zh: 士麦那的拉比，自称弥赛亚，后来改信伊斯兰教。

people.name: Kara Mustafa Pasha
people.known_for: Grand vizier who led the failed siege of Vienna in 1683.
people.known_for_zh: 大维齐尔，1683年率军围攻维也纳失败。

people.name: Ibrahim Muteferrika
people.known_for: Founded the first Ottoman press printing in Arabic script in 1727.
people.known_for_zh: 1727年创办第一家用阿拉伯字母印刷的奥斯曼印刷所。

people.name: Nedîm
people.known_for: Poet of the Tulip Era who celebrated the pleasures of Istanbul.
people.known_for_zh: 郁金香时代的诗人，歌咏伊斯坦布尔的游乐生活。

people.name: Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab
people.name_zh: 穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜勒瓦哈卜
people.known_for: Preacher of Najd whose strict reform movement allied with the House of Saud.
people.known_for_zh: 内志的宣教者，发起严格的宗教改革运动，与沙特家族结盟。

people.name: Muhammad bin Saud
people.known_for: Emir of Diriyah who founded the first Saudi state.
people.known_for_zh: 德拉伊耶的埃米尔，建立第一沙特国。

people.name: Ahmad bin Said al-Busaidi
people.known_for: Founder of the Al Said dynasty that still rules Oman.
people.known_for_zh: 建立至今统治阿曼的赛义德王朝。

check.n_zh: 原作1710年，据维基百科和维基数据改为1694年。

people.name: Selim III
people.known_for: Reforming sultan who created a new European-style army and was overthrown for it.
people.known_for_zh: 改革派苏丹，建立欧式新军，因此被推翻。

people.name: Bashir Shihab II
people.known_for: Emir of Mount Lebanon for half a century, builder of Beiteddine Palace.
people.known_for_zh: 统治黎巴嫩山区半个世纪的埃米尔，修建了拜特丁宫。

Emirate of Nejd.name: Abdulaziz Ibn Saud
Emirate of Nejd.name_zh: 阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·本·沙特

people.name: Mustafa Reşid Pasha
people.known_for: Statesman who proclaimed the Tanzimat reforms in 1839.
people.known_for_zh: 政治家，1839年宣布坦齐马特改革。

people.name: Butrus al-Bustani
people.known_for: Lebanese scholar of the Arab literary revival who compiled the first Arabic encyclopedia.
people.known_for_zh: 黎巴嫩学者，阿拉伯文艺复兴的代表人物，编纂了第一部阿拉伯文百科全书。

people.name: Ahmed Cevdet Pasha
people.name_zh: 艾哈迈德·杰夫代特帕夏
people.known_for: Historian and jurist who led the codification of Islamic civil law in the Mecelle.
people.known_for_zh: 历史学家和法学家，主持编纂伊斯兰民法典《麦吉拉》。

people.name: Midhat Pasha
people.known_for: Grand vizier who drafted the first Ottoman constitution of 1876.
people.known_for_zh: 大维齐尔，主持制定1876年的第一部奥斯曼宪法。

people.name: Jamal al-Din al-Afghani
people.known_for: Pan-Islamic thinker who urged Muslims to unite and reform against European power.
people.known_for_zh: 泛伊斯兰主义思想家，号召穆斯林团结和改革以对抗欧洲列强。

people.name: Namık Kemal
people.known_for: Poet and journalist of the Young Ottomans who spread ideas of liberty and the nation.
people.known_for_zh: 青年奥斯曼党的诗人和记者，传播自由和民族思想。

people.name: Osman Hamdi Bey
people.known_for: Painter and archaeologist who founded the Istanbul Archaeology Museum.
people.known_for_zh: 画家和考古学家，创建伊斯坦布尔考古博物馆。

people.name: Abdul Hamid II
people.known_for: Sultan who suspended the constitution and ruled autocratically for three decades.
people.known_for_zh: 苏丹，中止宪法，专制统治三十年。

people.name: Abd al-Rahman al-Kawakibi
people.name_zh: 阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·卡瓦基比
people.known_for: Syrian writer who attacked despotism and was an early Arab nationalist.
people.known_for_zh: 叙利亚作家，抨击专制统治，是早期阿拉伯民族主义者。

people.name: Eliezer Ben-Yehuda
people.known_for: Lexicographer who led the revival of Hebrew as a spoken language.
people.known_for_zh: 词典编纂家，领导希伯来语复兴为日常口语。

people.name: Hussein bin Ali
people.known_for: Sharif of Mecca who launched the Arab Revolt against the Ottomans in 1916.
people.known_for_zh: 麦加谢里夫，1916年发动反抗奥斯曼的阿拉伯大起义。

people.name: Talaat Pasha
people.known_for: Leader of the Young Turk government in the First World War, chief organiser of the Armenian genocide.
people.known_for_zh: 第一次世界大战时青年土耳其党政府的领导人，亚美尼亚大屠杀的主要策划者。

people.name: Ziya Gökalp
people.known_for: Sociologist whose ideas shaped Turkish nationalism.
people.known_for_zh: 社会学家，他的思想塑造了土耳其民族主义。

people.name: Enver Pasha
people.known_for: Young Turk leader who brought the empire into the First World War.
people.known_for_zh: 青年土耳其党领导人，把帝国拖入第一次世界大战。

people.name: T. E. Lawrence
people.known_for: British officer who fought alongside the Arab Revolt, known as Lawrence of Arabia.
people.known_for_zh: 与阿拉伯起义军并肩作战的英国军官，人称“阿拉伯的劳伦斯”。

Mesopotamia (GB).name_zh: 伊拉克王国（英国委任统治）

Turkey.name: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk
Turkey.name_zh: 穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克

Saudi Arabia.name: Abdulaziz Ibn Saud
Saudi Arabia.name_zh: 阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·本·沙特
Saudi Arabia.note: Ruled Nejd from 1902 and Hejaz from 1926.
Saudi Arabia.note_zh: 1902年起统治内志，1926年起兼领汉志。

people.name: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk
people.name_zh: 穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克
people.known_for: Founder and first president of the Republic of Turkey, who made it a secular state.
people.known_for_zh: 土耳其共和国的缔造者和首任总统，把土耳其建成世俗国家。

people.name: İsmet İnönü
people.known_for: Atatürk's general and successor as president, who kept Turkey out of the Second World War.
people.known_for_zh: 凯末尔的将领和继任总统，使土耳其置身于第二次世界大战之外。

people.name: Ibn Saud
people.name_zh: 阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·本·沙特
people.known_for: Founder of Saudi Arabia, who retook Riyadh in 1902 and united most of Arabia.
people.known_for_zh: 沙特阿拉伯的建立者，1902年夺回利雅得，统一了阿拉伯半岛大部分地区。

people.name: Faisal I of Iraq
people.known_for: Leader of the Arab Revolt who became the first king of Iraq.
people.known_for_zh: 阿拉伯大起义的领导人，后来成为伊拉克第一任国王。

people.name: Abdullah I of Jordan
people.known_for: Founder of Transjordan and first king of Jordan, assassinated in Jerusalem.
people.known_for_zh: 外约旦的建立者和约旦首任国王，在耶路撒冷遇刺。

people.name: Gertrude Bell
people.known_for: British traveller and archaeologist who helped draw the borders of Iraq.
people.known_for_zh: 英国旅行家和考古学家，参与划定伊拉克的边界。

people.name: Chaim Weizmann
people.known_for: Zionist leader and chemist who later became the first president of Israel.
people.known_for_zh: 犹太复国主义领袖和化学家，后来成为以色列首任总统。

people.name: Sati' al-Husri
people.known_for: Educator who built Iraq's school system and was a leading theorist of Arab nationalism.
people.known_for_zh: 教育家，建立伊拉克的学校体系，是阿拉伯民族主义的重要理论家。

people.name: Izz ad-Din al-Qassam
people.known_for: Preacher in Haifa who led armed resistance to British rule and Zionist settlement.
people.known_for_zh: 海法的宣教者，领导武装反抗英国统治和犹太移民定居。

people.name: Halide Edib Adıvar
people.known_for: Turkish novelist and campaigner for women's rights in the War of Independence.
people.known_for_zh: 土耳其小说家，在独立战争中为妇女权利奔走。

people.name: Sultan al-Atrash
people.known_for: Druze leader of the Great Syrian Revolt against French rule in 1925.
people.known_for_zh: 德鲁兹派领袖，1925年领导反抗法国统治的叙利亚大起义。

people.name: Amin al-Husseini
people.known_for: Grand Mufti of Jerusalem and leader of Palestinian Arab nationalism under the British mandate.
people.known_for_zh: 耶路撒冷大穆夫提，英国委任统治时期巴勒斯坦阿拉伯民族运动的领导人。

people.name: Nâzım Hikmet
people.known_for: Modern Turkish poet who spent years in prison for his communist views.
people.known_for_zh: 土耳其现代诗人，因共产主义观点多年身陷囹圄。

works.title: Human Landscapes from My Country
works.title_zh: 我的同胞们的人文景观

people.name: Michel Aflaq
people.known_for: Syrian thinker who co-founded the Ba'ath Party in 1947.
people.known_for_zh: 叙利亚思想家，1947年参与创建复兴党。

Saudi Arabia.name: Abdulaziz Ibn Saud
Saudi Arabia.name_zh: 阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·本·沙特

Turkey.name: Celal Bayar
Turkey.note: Real power lay with Prime Minister Adnan Menderes.
Turkey.note_zh: 实权在总理阿德南·曼德列斯手中。

Turkey.name: Ahmet Necdet Sezer
Turkey.name_zh: 艾哈迈德·内吉德特·塞泽尔

Turkey.name: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan
Turkey.name_zh: 雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安

Iraq.name: Abd al-Karim Qasim
Iraq.name_zh: 阿卜杜勒·卡里姆·卡塞姆
Iraq.note: Prime minister and real ruler of the new republic.
Iraq.note_zh: 总理，新共和国的实际统治者。

Iraq.name: Abdul Salam Arif
Iraq.name_zh: 阿卜杜勒·萨拉姆·阿里夫

Iraq.name: Abdul Rahman Arif
Iraq.name_zh: 阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·阿里夫

Iraq.name: Nouri al-Maliki
Iraq.note: Prime minister, the most powerful office after 2005.
Iraq.note_zh: 总理，2005年后的最高实权职位。

Iraq.name: Adil Abdul-Mahdi
Iraq.name_zh: 阿迪勒·阿卜杜勒-迈赫迪

people.name: David Ben-Gurion
people.known_for: Proclaimed the State of Israel in 1948 and was its first prime minister.
people.known_for_zh: 1948年宣布以色列建国，并任首任总理。

people.name: Golda Meir
people.known_for: Prime minister of Israel during the 1973 Yom Kippur War.
people.known_for_zh: 1973年赎罪日战争时期的以色列总理。

people.name: Faisal of Saudi Arabia
people.known_for: Saudi king who modernised the state and led the 1973 oil embargo.
people.known_for_zh: 沙特国王，推动国家现代化，领导了1973年的石油禁运。

people.name: Adnan Menderes
people.known_for: First freely elected prime minister of Turkey, executed after the 1960 coup.
people.known_for_zh: 土耳其第一位经自由选举产生的总理，1960年政变后被处死。

people.name: Moshe Dayan
people.known_for: Israeli general and defence minister in the Six-Day War of 1967.
people.known_for_zh: 以色列将领，1967年六日战争时任国防部长。

people.name: Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan
people.name_zh: 扎耶德·本·苏尔坦·阿勒纳哈扬
people.known_for: Founder and first president of the United Arab Emirates.
people.known_for_zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国的缔造者和首任总统。

people.name: Menachem Begin
people.known_for: Israeli prime minister who signed the Camp David peace with Egypt.
people.known_for_zh: 以色列总理，与埃及签署戴维营和平协议。

people.name: Yitzhak Rabin
people.known_for: Prime minister who signed the Oslo Accords and was assassinated in 1995.
people.known_for_zh: 签署奥斯陆协议的以色列总理，1995年遇刺身亡。

people.name: Shimon Peres
people.known_for: Israeli prime minister and president, Nobel Peace laureate for the Oslo Accords.
people.known_for_zh: 以色列总理和总统，因奥斯陆协议获诺贝尔和平奖。

people.name: Nizar Qabbani
people.known_for: Syrian poet of love and of political protest, among the most read Arab poets.
people.known_for_zh: 叙利亚诗人，写爱情诗和政治抗议诗，是读者最多的阿拉伯诗人之一。

people.name: Yaşar Kemal
people.known_for: Turkish novelist of the peasants of Anatolia.
people.known_for_zh: 描写安纳托利亚农民的土耳其小说家。

people.name: Yehuda Amichai
people.known_for: The best-known modern Hebrew poet.
people.known_for_zh: 最著名的现代希伯来语诗人。

people.name: Yasser Arafat
people.known_for: Leader of the PLO who signed the Oslo Accords and headed the Palestinian Authority.
people.known_for_zh: 巴勒斯坦解放组织领导人，签署奥斯陆协议，领导巴勒斯坦民族权力机构。

people.name: Hafez al-Assad
people.known_for: President of Syria from 1971 to 2000.
people.known_for_zh: 1971年至2000年任叙利亚总统。

people.name: Hussein of Jordan
people.known_for: King of Jordan for 46 years who made peace with Israel in 1994.
people.known_for_zh: 在位46年的约旦国王，1994年与以色列媾和。

people.name: Saddam Hussein
people.known_for: Dictator of Iraq who invaded Iran and Kuwait and was overthrown in 2003.
people.known_for_zh: 伊拉克独裁者，曾入侵伊朗和科威特，2003年被推翻。

people.name: Amos Oz
people.known_for: Israeli novelist and advocate of peace with the Palestinians.
people.known_for_zh: 以色列小说家，主张与巴勒斯坦人和平共处。

works.title: A Tale of Love and Darkness

people.name: Qaboos bin Said
people.known_for: Sultan who modernised Oman over fifty years.
people.known_for_zh: 在位五十年、使阿曼走向现代化的苏丹。

people.name: Mahmoud Darwish
people.known_for: Palestinian national poet.
people.known_for_zh: 巴勒斯坦的民族诗人。

people.name: Rafic Hariri
people.known_for: Prime minister who rebuilt Beirut after the Lebanese civil war and was assassinated.
people.known_for_zh: 黎巴嫩总理，内战后主持重建贝鲁特，后遇刺身亡。
